query: Which diagnostics and reparameterization strategies (posterior coverage, rank histograms, profile likelihood, orthogonalization) most effectively assess parameter recovery and reduce collinearity?

response.query: Which diagnostics and reparameterization strategies (posterior coverage, rank histograms, profile likelihood, orthogonalization) most effectively assess parameter recovery and reduce collinearity?
response.answer: Posterior coverage, rank histograms, and profile likelihood effectively assess parameter recovery, while orthogonalization reduces collinearity. These strategies are widely used in Bayesian statistics and model diagnostics.

results.content: | Highlight | VideoScene: Distilling Video Diffusion Model to Generate 3D Scenes in One Step  Poster  Hanyang Wang · Fangfu Liu · Jiawei Chi · Yueqi Duan  [ ExHall D ]  Abstract Recovering 3D scenes from sparse views is a challenging task due to its inherent ill-posed problem. | Highlight | Seeing More with Less: Human-like Representations in Vision Models  Poster  Andrey Gizdov · Shimon Ullman · Daniel Harari  [ ExHall D ]  Abstract Large multimodal models (LMMs) typically process visual inputs with uniform resolution across the entire field of view, leading to inefficiencies when non-critical image regions are processed as precisely as key areas. | Highlight | Learning 4D Panoptic Scene Graph Generation from Rich 2D Visual Scene  Poster  Shengqiong Wu · Hao Fei · Jingkang Yang · Xiangtai Li · Juncheng Li · Hanwang Zhang · Tat-seng Chua  [ ExHall D ]  Abstract The latest emerged 4D Panoptic Scene Graph (4D-PSG) provides an advanced-ever representation for comprehensively modeling the dynamic 4D visual real world.
